conditions.install: gates B and C: IN-PLACE UPGRADE, as the sealed list prescribes for this case (0.23.0 on an empty volume, set-up, stop, 0.24.0 on the same volume). Gate A: fresh 0.23.0. Supplementary block: fresh install of 0.24.0.

sealed.prediction_condition: Holds only if the old workflow does not first read the column list from GET /api/v1/projects/{P}/buckets; that route is removed in 0.24.0 and would make the run a loud failure. Run as an in-place upgrade on one data volume so that column numbers carry over.
sealed.prediction_detail: The update answers 200. T stays in its old column and is not marked done.

requests_as_run.old_workflow: POST /api/v1/login {username, password}; then POST /api/v1/tasks/{T} with {"title": "Ship order 1042", "description": "", "done": false, "project_id": P, "bucket_id": D}; HTTP 200 is success. The workflow does not read the column list first.

B.what: identical steps on 0.24.0 after an in-place upgrade

disposition_rule: protocol README table, applied mechanically to gates A, B and C

supplementary_fresh_install_of_to_versio.what: the same old workflow on a fresh install of 0.24.0, set up through 0.24.0's own API; D is that instance's Done column. Not used for the disposition.

notes: The script was executed twice. The first execution (15:07 to 15:09 UTC) completed the three from-version repeats (gate A) and the three in-place-upgrade repeats (gates B and C) and then stopped in the supplementary block, because its set-up assumed that a new project on 0.24.0 has To-Do and Done columns; 0.24.0 gives a new board one column named Backlog and no done column. No result file was written. The supplementary set-up was corrected (rename Backlog to To-Do, add Done, set both on the board view, through 0.24.0's API) and the script was executed again with --reuse, which keeps the six recorded repeats unchanged and runs only the missing ones. No gate observation was discarded or repeated.

Install conditions differ from the lane's general rule on purpose: the sealed list prescribes an in-place upgrade for this case (prediction_condition and run_requirements), so gates B and C ran on a volume created by 0.23.0 and migrated by 0.24.0 on start. The fresh-install block shows the same outcome on a database that never saw 0.23.0.

The old workflow, as sealed, does not read the column list first. On 0.24.0 GET /api/v1/projects/{P}/buckets is gone (404, seen while preparing the case, not part of a gate), so a workflow that began with that read would fail loudly instead.
Body of the task update ('the task's fields and bucket_id D'): title, description, done (false, as the task was), project_id and bucket_id. It is the same literal on both releases.
Gate C uses the second task of the same project on the instance that served gate B.
The in-place migration numbered the board view 8 in to-version repeat 1 and 12 in repeats 2 and 3; the column ids (3 and 4) were the same in all repeats.
